summary: Preinstall beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded remote endpoints
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs beacon.js on npm install. beacon.js collects host identity data (os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, process.platform, process.arch) and transmits it to two hardcoded remote destinations: an HTTP GET to a bare IP at 104.236.2.79/npm-install and an HTTPS GET to m3p49wwj8ttzz98h.datasafeservices.com/npm-install. The beacon fires automatically at install time without user interaction and without disclosure in the package's documented purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
